test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 18 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cages are nests.

Some nests are houses.

No house is a den.

Conclusions:

(I): No cage is a den.

(II): Some houses are cages.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6df8e1f3399af829e9833d7c064c693d0b3c1dc55d6cc3baca673384c54bc35.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): No cage is a den → False (As, there is no direct relation betweem them)

(II): Some houses are cages → False (As, there is no direct relation betweem them)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
